Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3dc792ca08888192b890f5ebd273cfd9 as of 2026-09-15T07:02:16.465Z: {"title":"AugMind — Agnostic Delivery Methodology (Living Draft)"} null **Status:** Draft — advisory only, client-agnostic, numbered for traceability. ## 00 — Purpose This is the reusable method for advisory engagements. It is not client-specific. Tranzon Key is the first application, not the definition. ## 01 — Three Frameworks 1. Structured listening — capture the client's situation in their own words before any solution is offered. 2. Structured problem decomposition — break the gap between current state and future state into manageable workstreams. 3. Advisory gates — every stage has a decision, a deliverable, and a gate where the client can accept or stop. ## 02 — Delivery Stages ### Stage 01 — Discover and Recommend Decision: Is there a defined problem worth solving, and is the client ready to act? Work: - 1.1 Structured listening - 1.2 Current-state assessment — data-driven baseline of operations, finances, processes, environment - 1.3 Future-state definition - 1.4 Structured problem decomposition - 1.5 Evidence review against benchmarks - 1.6 Recommendation Deliverable D1.4: single Statement of Work covering all five stages. Gate G1: client accepts the recommendation and signs the Statement of Work, or names specific gaps. Silence is not acceptance. ### Stage 02 — Design and Plan Decision: Is the plan actionable, measurable, and within scope? Work: - 2.1 Business case and future-state operating model - 2.2 Implementation roadmap and action plan - 2.3 Measurement lock — success metric in the client's words, data source, named owner - 2.4 Change-control process defined Deliverable D2.1: plan with locked metric, source, and owner. Gate G2: client signs the plan. ### Stage 03 — Implement Decision: Are the processes live and documented? Work: - 3.1 Detailed process designs - 3.2 Organizational and technological requirements - 3.3 Results Management Office to drive, coordinate, support, measure, and track Deliverable D3.1: live processes and documented runbook. Gate G3: first cycle shows movement on the locked metric. ### Stage 04 — Validate and Run Decision: Can the client accept the result, and is it ready to run under AugMind? Work: - 4.1 Check against acceptance criteria - 4.2 Transfer ownership and access - 4.3 Stand up the repeatable process — automation, monitoring, operating cadence Deliverable D4.1: accepted deliverables plus a running process with named owners, support boundaries, and a recurring operating plan. Gate G4: client accepts the run state or names gaps. Running starts only after acceptance. ### Stage 05 — Review results and improve Decision: Is the engagement producing measurable improvement? Work: - 5.1 Trend analysis across cycles - 5.2 Refine targeting and update benchmark comparison - 5.3 Quality review — risk-based, one named reviewer outside the delivery team on higher-value work Deliverable D5.1: improvement report and next-cycle plan. Gate G5: named reviewer signs off before anything returns to the client. ## 03 — Quality Gate (Advisory-Grade) Not audit. Risk-based review by one named person outside the delivery team on higher-value or higher-risk work. KPMG Advisory Quality Performance Reviews are performed by the Functional Quality and Risk Management Partner, rated green, yellow, or red on engagement set-up and execution. Source: KPMG Integrated Report 2024/2025. ## 04 — Pricing Partners adopt the rate card before any Statement of Work ships. Client never sees "proposed." Four ways to buy: diagnostic, fixed-fee project, range with cap, capacity. Recurring tier for the run model. No rate discounts — scope shrinks instead. ## 05 — Evidence Base - KPMG current-state baseline: [https://kpmg.com/us/en/how-we-work/client-stories/charting-course-new-value.html](https://kpmg.com/us/en/how-we-work/client-stories/charting-course-new-value.html) - KPMG stage gates (GETT): [https://assets.kpmg.com/content/dam/kpmgsites/be/pdf/ALL-Quality-Assurance-and-Business-Integration-on-SAP-S4HANA-transformations-2026-EN-brochure-022-A4.pdf.coredownload.inline.pdf](https://assets.kpmg.com/content/dam/kpmgsites/be/pdf/ALL-Quality-Assurance-and-Business-Integration-on-SAP-S4HANA-transformations-2026-EN-brochure-022-A4.pdf.coredownload.inline.pdf) - Deloitte current-state to future-state: [https://www2.deloitte.com/content/dam/assets-zone3/us/en/docs/services/consulting/2024/us-cons-enterprise-service-management-accelerating-your-journey.pdf](https://www2.deloitte.com/content/dam/assets-zone3/us/en/docs/services/consulting/2024/us-cons-enterprise-service-management-accelerating-your-journey.pdf) - Deloitte change control: Deloitte UK supplier terms, Schedule 4. - WordStream real-estate search benchmarks: CTR 7.61%, CPC \$3.22, conversion 3.70%, CPL \$102.51. - Gartner three metric classes: relationship, transactional, operational. - Forrester campaign hierarchy: Reputation, Demand, Engagement, Enablement. ## 06 — Traceability Framework → Stage → Work item → Deliverable → Gate. Nothing floats. ## 07 — Red-Team Notes - SPIN removed — sales methodology, not advisory. - Hypothesis tree removed — McKinsey/BCG/Bain, not Big Four. - "Attestor" replaced with "owner" — advisory framing. - No audit language anywhere. - Every claim has a link or is labeled as a placeholder pending real data. --- *Living draft. Edit in place. Export to PDF or Word for the canonical Drive copy when locked.* ## 08 — Rate Card and Pricing Instrument **Source of truth (Drive):** [AugMind_Rate card and terms_2026-09-14_v1.4_PROPOSED.md](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I1uivUdBJKHpdgFpD7PxOUdfMlVYGy5V/view) **Companion worksheet (internal):** [AugMind_Deal-pricing worksheet_2026-09-14_v1.2_PROPOSED.xlsx](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19QC6SZoNRxglxgRIqXa6mfVgaFyDA742/edit) **Pricing methodology (internal):** [AugMind_Pricing Methodology_2026-09-14_v1.0_PROPOSED.docx](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TdyAMsuwbej5H1jeNNVBsZNij38OKlSA/edit) ### Summary (agnostic) - Price named people at published rates by level. A day is eight hours; half-day is four. - Partner \$3,000/day; Director/engagement lead \$2,400/day; Subject-matter expert \$2,400–\$3,000/day; Manager \$2,000/day; Senior consultant/specialist \$1,600/day; Consultant/specialist \$1,200/day; Analyst \$900/day. - Four ways to buy: Diagnostic, Fixed-fee project, Range with cap, Capacity. - Diagnostic: Focused \$11,100 (one week); Full \$17,500 (two weeks). Credited in full against follow-on work within 90 days. - Capacity example: director one day/week ≈ \$10,400/month; senior specialist 20 hours/month = \$4,000/month. - Tools inside the rate. Client-owned software, platforms, ad spend, and data passed through at cost with zero markup. - No rate discounts. If the number must come down, scope shrinks. - Partners adopt the rate card before any Statement of Work ships. Client never sees “proposed.” - Recurring tier supports the Validate and Run model. ### Open partner decisions (internal) 1. Revenue need and partner-day value. 2. Subcontractor model. 3. Technology fee inside rate or flat platform fee. 4. Diagnostic prices. 5. Deposit and payment shape. 6. Whether committed capacity earns a lower rate. --- ## 09 — Research and Evidence Library **Navigation (Drive):** [00 START HERE — AugMind methodology and evidence.md](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hEazxyA7LtcPMEaDNDfsiQTAy67KRhT7/view) ### External digital marketing evidence **Source (Drive):** [AugMind - External digital marketing evidence and end state - 2026-09-14.md](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZW0w4_AIkHmJ5A4TE76SNSDgY1nJ8xJ_/view)
Evidence Published figures How to use it
Paid search, 2026 Median lead cost \$66.69 across industries; \$93.69 Business Services; \$102.51 Real Estate. Initial inquiry economics; not customer acquisition cost.
Real-estate search detail, 2026 Selected sales/agent/brokerage medians \$142.59–\$162.39 per lead; 1.29%–1.83% conversion. Match business segment and tracked action before comparison.
Real-estate email MailerLite median recipient click rate 1.72%; overall 2.09%. Assess message/audience engagement, then track resulting inquiries and opportunities.
Landing pages Unbounce overall median conversion 6.6%. Reference for pages with comparable actions and traffic; not a sales conversion target.
Secondary social WordStream Facebook 2025 median real-estate lead cost \$16.61; overall \$27.66. Weaker directional evidence; cheaper raw inquiries do not establish cheaper qualified opportunities.
Planning band: approximately \$100–\$165 per search inquiry summarizes published overall real-estate and selected sales/brokerage medians. Reference band, not an interval containing most campaigns. ### Analyst and operating evidence - Gartner 2025 marketing-technology survey: average utilization 49% of available stack capabilities, up from 33% in 2023. Enterprise-heavy sample (77% \$1B+ revenue). Assess existing capabilities before recommending purchases. - Gartner 2026 CMO survey: marketing budgets averaging 7.8% of revenue. Context only — not a budget prescription for a small business. - Forrester 2025 B2B research (1,060 decision-makers): businesses consistently applying leading practices reported average annual revenue growth of 11%, versus under 1% for laggards. Association, not proof of causation. - Public analyst material does not supply a suitable small-business CPC/CPL table. Use analysts for operating evidence; use channel datasets for channel economics. ### Named case references (directional only) - Anderson & Garland (UK auction house, vendor-reported): 56% more valuation requests, 28% lower cost per valuation after restructuring campaigns, testing creative/audiences, and focusing spend. No absolute baseline counts or exact comparison dates. - Forrester Molly Maid account: 55% conversion over 30 days following AI receptionist implementation. Reported conversion level, not 55% improvement; baseline, sample size, and full conversion definition absent. ### Source-handling rules - Every non-U.S. figure is converted to U.S. dollars at the time of citation. - Vendor-reported cases are directional, never typical uplift or assurance of causality. - No ROI is calculated from property value, double-counted business, or equated hours released with cash savings. - Sequence: baseline and compare → identify the constraint → scope and price a useful improvement → run a bounded test → evaluate quality/economics → expand where justified. ### Research folders (Drive) - [Gartner, Forrester and marketing KPIs — research](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Kd6iSoZQ0u18su1LmnXkrdugCPJL9hZg) - [Past delivered projects — research and benchmarks](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NErk7jp083jNw6eyQd3fqd6SqYmi4IOX) - [Research — pricing and staffing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HVU1St3V9vsvQ_k2wOEETbuloArVVjCf) - [AugMind_Delivery_Deloitte-KPMG-benchmark_2026-09-14_Review.md](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GX2qNe5A9Qj6m1gHaPKN_6N9fKsF72Em/view) - [AugMind — KPMG traceability rationale and sources — 2026-09-14.md](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Zy95p6m0tx2NnpNrLAB08CKdiBbP8ZOB/view)
